first.prompt: Create one square photorealistic menu photograph for a fictional Japanese ramen restaurant, Demo Ramen. Dish: tonkotsu ramen, creamy ivory pork broth, thin noodles, two slices of chashu pork, half a soft-boiled egg, sliced scallions, nori. A single matte dark charcoal ceramic bowl on a warm medium brown wooden table. Soft natural light from upper left, calm warm restaurant mood, realistic appetizing food, camera at a slightly elevated three-quarter angle. Center the full bowl with enough breathing room for a square menu crop. No chopsticks covering the food, no people, no text, no logos, no watermark. Opaque background. This is the first of a coherent restaurant menu series; use simple composition and natural colors.
